event_name: Date 08 June 2019 Time 18:13 2019 CANADIAN GRAND PRIX 6 - 9 June 2019 The Stewards have received a request from Rich Energy Haas F1 Team to re-scrutineer car 20 which has had a change of the survival cell. In accordance with Article 25.2 and Article 25.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations, the Stewards agreed that this can take place on June 9th before 12:00hrs Local Time. In accordance with Art 23.2 the car will be required to start the race from the pit lane.
rules_referenced: Article 25.4 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
title: Decision Car 20 Re Scrutineering Request
